title: AI layer (process-map-ai-opportunity)
description: process-map-ai-opportunity/<name>.json: the AI layer over one current-state map. It names its base map and adds ai[] items; it never changes the base. Lanes, nodes, edges, cards, systems, client and footer all come from the base. No AI field is stored on a node: each item points at steps or groups. Field meanings and elements are in design-system/process-map-ai-opportunity/README.md.

base.description: The name of a valid map in process-map/ of the same workspace.

meta.description: Replaces the base's header text and, when given, its date.

ai.description: Sorted by id. An empty list is valid and draws the empty state.

aiId.description: Its two digits are what the square shows (AI-07 shows 07).

title.description: Sentence case, starts with a verb, no final full stop.

origin.description: named: the client asked for it in their own words. suggested: our idea. Drives filled or outlined marks everywhere.

does.description: What it would do, in one to three sentences.

nodes.description: Base steps (kind step) it touches; each gets a halo and a square. Default [].

groups.description: Base group ids (a view-level item marks the group cell, not its steps), or "all" for one board-wide item. Default []. Needs a base with two or more groups.

agentic.description: How the item would run as an agent. Our design, not a claim: it cites nothing, but its numbers must occur in records the item cites (prose-4).

decides.description: Where a person decides. An agentic version with no human decision is invalid.

after.description: The step number (from 1) after which the person decides.

what.description: A lower-case clause: 'checks the entry and accepts or corrects it'.

logging.description: What every run records, and where.
